summary: Configured node1 with the key-only SFTP account dropbox, confined to /srv/sftp/dropbox. The writable incoming directory is empty after validation. Configuration and SFTP access survived the mandatory node reboot.
actions_performed: Created dropbox with /incoming as its home and /sbin/nologin as its shell.
Created the root-owned chroot and dropbox-owned incoming directory (mode 0750).
Generated an ED25519 credential on node1; the root-only private key is /root/.ssh/dropbox_sftp_ed25519.
Configured OpenSSH to force internal-sftp, require public-key authentication, and disable shell, TTY, tunnels, and forwarding.
Verified uploads, downloads, checksum integrity, shell denial, and chroot confinement.
Rebooted node1 safely and repeated service, persistence, read/write, and shell-denial checks.
Removed validation files from incoming after testing.

evidence.summary: Confirms the account, root-owned chroot, dropbox-owned writable incoming directory, SELinux label, and clean final state.
Effective policy forces internal-sftp and disables forwarding/TTY; live tests deny shell access and host filesystem access.
Live SFTP uploads succeeded as dropbox, including after restart; final probe was removed successfully.
ED25519 credential was generated on node1 without exposing private material; authorized key permissions and SELinux context are correct.

Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09 to 9cc3f2f9-c016-4dd2-9244-81e9f8df0733, and recovered SSH/SFTP service with persisted data and successful post-restart read/write.
